messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: changing column name based on a variable
parts:
Hi
may be my example help you to do what you want
nitem=15
nitem1=nitem+1
nitem2=2*nitem
string <-  sprintf('F1=1-%i 
                           F2=%i-%i 
                           COV=F1*F2',nitem,nitem1,nitem2)
